_comment: verify-kani-mutation manifest — the Kani-side analogue of the Lean verify-proof-mutation gate (anti-vacuity for the firmware bounded-verification harnesses). For each entry, mutate a decoder/gate function in a way a specific Kani harness MUST catch, run ONLY that harness, and assert it flips to `VERIFICATION:- FAILED`. A green-when-it-should-be-red = a vacuous / under-constrained harness (the exact failure class the per-slice manual mutation checks caught by hand; this makes them a standing gate — work-todo §34/§35). Paths are relative to the repo root. Every entry uses `expect: kani_fails` (the load-bearing mutation must be caught); the `canary` doubles as the machinery-health check (if it survives, ALL results are void).

mutations.note: verify_rollback always-accepts -> the rollback_boundary biconditional (is_ok() <=> version > floor) MUST break. If this SURVIVES, the harness machinery is broken (kani not running / output not parsed) and every result is void.
the real anti-rollback off-by-one: `>=` would let a version==floor reinstall slip past the OTP rollback floor.
the execute(...) head->tail ABI offset byte; a wrong value = calldata the on-chain wallet mis-decodes into a different call.
perturb the multiSend record-walk cursor advance -> the exact-tiling partition proof MUST break (a hidden byte would ride between records).
excluding Blind from the value-page rule would silently drop a Blind record's non-zero native value -> the no-hidden-value WYSIWYS proof MUST break.
shift a GPv2Order field read by one byte -> the verbatim-offset decode-soundness biconditional MUST break.

disable the per-record op==0 DELEGATECALL-refusal in summarize_packed -> a payload carrying an op!=0 record is now accepted, so summarize_accept_implies_all_call's `Ok => forall record: operation==0` re-walk assertion MUST break. Verified 2026-07-01 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED via assert_failed_inner (the assert_eq!(rec.operation, 0) firing), unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. Closes finding 3b-1's anti-vacuity guard (ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_KANI_2026-07-01.md); the only kani_mutations entry outside the original 4-file curated set.

disable read_address_word_off's top-12-zero address-canonicity reject -> a dirty-padding address word (to/gas_token/refund_receiver) is accepted, so decode_exec_rejects_noncanonical_address (expects NonCanonicalAddress) MUST break. Verified 2026-07-02 by hand: mutation -> BOTH decode_exec_rejects_noncanonical_address AND decode_exec_soundness (accept-direction top-12==0 assert) -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. Closes finding 3b/#4 (exec address canonicity had NO harness; deleting the reject kept all 12 safe_tx harnesses green).

disable the dynamic-array element cap (step 7) -> a 9-element sole-tail body is accepted, so resolve_array_rejects_over_cap (expects Reject) MUST break. Verified 2026-07-02 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. Closes finding §2 #2 (the cap was UNREACHABLE in the symbolic panic-free harnesses at N=160/224 which admit only count<=2/4, so `count<=MAX_ARRAY_RENDER` there was vacuous; the concrete control at 384 B exercises it).

make lookup_enum_label's per-entry key comparison always-true -> the first entry matches any (high-zero) value, so the returned label is entry 0's regardless of which key the value actually matches. enum_two_entry_value_sound (a value matching key1, not key0, must return label1) MUST break. Verified 2026-07-02 by hand: mutation -> enum_two_entry_value_sound (and enum_single_entry_value_sound) VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. Closes finding §2 #3 (the single-entry harness only proved the match where first==correct; the multi-entry return-the-matching-entry property was unverified).

under-report the single-byte item's consumed count (used 1 -> 0) -> ListIter's `&self.rest[used..]` would re-read the same byte (a parse desync). The strengthened `assert_eq!(used, header_len + payload.len())` (header_len derived independently from the RLP prefix byte) MUST break; the old `used <= len` assert would have PASSED with used=0. Verified 2026-07-02 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. Closes finding §2 #10.

read transferFrom's `to` from word 0 (the `from` word) instead of word 1 -> the display would show the WRONG recipient for the approval-drain arm. parse_erc20_transfer_from_no_misdecode (decoded to == encoded to, forall) MUST break. Verified 2026-07-02 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. Closes finding §2 #9 (only `transfer` had a forall no-misdecode harness; approve/transferFrom rested on point-tests).

[§2 #1: Safe-mgmt owner/module address decode] Breaks decode_addr_word: reads the 20-byte address one byte too low (word[11..31] instead of the canonical word[12..32]), so the decoded owner is shifted off the ABI-encoded word. The concrete non-vacuity harness asserts new_owner[0]==0xaa and new_owner[19]==0xbb at their exact canonical offsets, which the shifted decode violates. Verified 2026-07-02 by a workflow agent in an isolated worktree (mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED, revert -> SUCCESSFUL); the file is UNCHANGED on origin/master since (0 commits in 63e29450..e4afbafa), so the deterministic kani verification transfers. Closes finding §2 #1 (mutation-gate breadth: this file had harnesses but no vacuity screen).

[§2 #1: typed-call ABI dynamic-tail bounds] Breaks the dynamic bytes/string payload-size accounting in walk: treats every dynamic payload as zero-length, so the tail bounds check (end = offset+32+padded_payload) under-reserves space and walk accepts a frame whose actual renderer read extent (body_off+32+count) runs past body.len(). The soundness harness reconstructs the renderer's UNPADDED read extent independently via renderer_read_end and asserts it is <= body.len(); the mutation makes that assertion (abi.rs:417) fail. Verified 2026-07-02 by a workflow agent in an isolated worktree (mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED, revert -> SUCCESSFUL); the file is UNCHANGED on origin/master since (0 commits in 63e29450..e4afbafa), so the deterministic kani verification transfers. Closes finding §2 #1 (mutation-gate breadth: this file had harnesses but no vacuity screen).

[§2 #1: NS-ptr shared-mailbox overlap reject] Flips the write-path shared-mailbox overlap reject in ns_write_window_ok: `ptr < r.mailbox_end` -> `ptr > r.mailbox_end`. This makes a range straddling the mailbox lower boundary (ptr = mailbox_base-4, len 8) pass the overlap guard, so the TOCTOU-critical mailbox carve-out is no longer rejected. Find string is unique to line 90 (line 122's read-path check is prefixed `if in_sram && ptr ...`). Verified 2026-07-02 by a workflow agent in an isolated worktree (mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED, revert -> SUCCESSFUL); the file is UNCHANGED on origin/master since (0 commits in 63e29450..e4afbafa), so the deterministic kani verification transfers. Closes finding §2 #1 (mutation-gate breadth: this file had harnesses but no vacuity screen).

[§2 #1: ERC-7730 enum_ref u16 decode] Swaps the two enum_ref payload bytes, breaking the big-endian u16 value decode. The harness reconstructs the expected value as u16::from_be_bytes([pool[4], pool[5]]) from the original pool at the fixed offset, so the swap produces the wrong value whenever payload[0]!=payload[1]. Verified 2026-07-02 by a workflow agent in an isolated worktree (mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED, revert -> SUCCESSFUL); the file is UNCHANGED on origin/master since (0 commits in 63e29450..e4afbafa), so the deterministic kani verification transfers. Closes finding §2 #1 (mutation-gate breadth: this file had harnesses but no vacuity screen).

[§2 #1: ERC-7730 leaf-offset bounds reject (slow ~460s -> full tier)] Drops the final leaf bounds reject so resolve_structured returns Ok(Leaf::Word/Dynamic(pos)) even when pos+32 > body.len() (a FieldIdx-terminated program with a large slot). The harness asserts every returned leaf offset satisfies off.checked_add(32) <= body.len(), which the removed check enforced. Verified 2026-07-02 by a workflow agent in an isolated worktree (mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED, revert -> SUCCESSFUL); the file is UNCHANGED on origin/master since (0 commits in 63e29450..e4afbafa), so the deterministic kani verification transfers. Closes finding §2 #1 (mutation-gate breadth: this file had harnesses but no vacuity screen).

shift the dynamic `data` payload start by -32 (read the length word as the payload) -> the rendered data slice starts 32 bytes early. decode_exec_data_slice_fidelity (d.data[i] == head[data_off+32+i], verbatim, for <=8-byte payloads; data_off + declared length re-read INDEPENDENTLY from the head bytes) MUST break. Verified 2026-07-02 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. Closes finding §2 #5 (the empty-tail decode_exec_soundness + the single concrete offset-320 witness did not cover the data-slice content for symbolic offsets; the module note declined the biconditional as decoder-echo, but the payload-shift is a real gap this bounded fidelity harness closes).

weaken the EIP-712 typed-frame EXACT-consumption guard (`!=` -> `>`) so a payload with hidden trailing bytes after the trailer is accepted -> parse_frame_panic_free_and_exact's `trailer ends at payload.len()` assertion MUST break. Verified 2026-07-02 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. Closes review finding (h): the offchain EIP712_TYPED/_V3 companion header parser had no host-Kani coverage; now extracted to pqsigner_aa::offchain_header (behaviour-identical, re-wired into cmd_sign_offchain.rs) + panic/OOB + exact-consumption harnesses.

mutations.find: Some(e) if e <= buf.len() && e <= MAX_APDU_RX => e,
mutations.note: remove the HID-reassembly continuation bounds guard so `buf[rx_pos..end]` writes past the caller's reassembly buffer -> process_frame_continuation_no_oob (arbitrary assembler state incl. rx_pos over MAX_APDU_RX + a symbolic continuation frame) MUST hit an out-of-bounds slice write. Verified 2026-07-02 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. Closes the S-USB-OVERFLOW row of contracts/verification/docs/THREAT_CLAIM_MAP.md (UNCLAIMED -> PARTIAL): the attacker-facing USB APDU reassembly (shared/src/apdu_framing.rs, the one layer between a malicious USB host and the firmware) had proptest fuzz coverage but no exhaustive Kani panic/OOB proof. NB: with buf sized exactly MAX_APDU_RX the two guard conjuncts (e <= buf.len(), e <= MAX_APDU_RX) are individually redundant so dropping ONE is not catchable; this removes the guard entirely (the load-bearing memory-safety check).

[work-todo §12e: off-chain counter sequence/interleave harness] Disable the MAX_OFFCHAIN_GAP gate in check_offchain_gate -> an accept can now be granted with gap >= 100, so offchain_gate_accept_is_sound's post-state gap bound (new_count - last_userop <= MAX_OFFCHAIN_GAP, i.e. gap+1) MUST break. Verified 2026-07-03 by hand (verify_mutations.sh): mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. Guards the doc-baseline single-gate soundness proof (firmware-bounded-verification-sota-2026-06.md:81) against vacuity. `check_offchain_gate` is called in place by cmd_sign_offchain.rs so this is the shipped gate.

[work-todo §12e] Disable the combined few-time-budget cap (userop_sigs + off-chain) in check_offchain_gate -> an accept can now push userop_sigs + new_count past MAX_SLOT_USES, so offchain_gate_accept_is_sound's combined-cap assertion MUST break. Verified 2026-07-03 by hand (verify_mutations.sh): mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. This is the MEDIUM-2 counter-replay cap (a withheld/reverted UserOp never bumps on-chain slotUses, so the device tallies its own Type-2 sigs); the harness now guards it non-vacuously.

[work-todo §12e: page-123 exhaustion brick, the found HIGH] Drop the already_present short-circuit from may_create_distinct_slot -> an EXISTING slot is now refused once distinct_live reaches the cap, i.e. a spray of distinct keys could wedge a live slot. distinct_slot_policy_graceful (asserts may_create_distinct_slot(any, true) is ALWAYS true) MUST break. Verified 2026-07-03 by hand (verify_mutations.sh): mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL. Pins the VULN-offchain-sync-page123-exhaustion-brick.md defence: at the cap, new-slot creation fails gracefully while existing slots keep signing.

array_elem_address off-by-one lets idx == count through (reads one word past the last element). The panic-free harness stays green (the read is still bounds-checked); the VALUE harness's `idx < count` oracle assertion MUST redden. Verified 2026-07-04 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL.

under-report the element count by one (the renderer would silently HIDE the last element from review). The count == read_length_word oracle binding MUST redden. Verified 2026-07-04 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL.

[-20:] tail anchor drifts one byte early (data[len-21..len-1]) -- still in-bounds, so panic-free stays green; the byte-binding `addr == data[len-20..len]` MUST redden. Verified 2026-07-04 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL.

FieldIdx slot accumulation drifts by +1 per op (the walker-slot-confusion class). Resolved leaf lands one word off; `Word(32*(s1+s2))` MUST redden. Verified 2026-07-04 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; unmutated -> SUCCESSFUL.

unlimited-threshold gate off-by-one: value == threshold no longer selects the Unlimited arm (the single most dangerous approval renders as a normal amount). REPOINTED 2026-07-06 (M4 amount-decision factoring): the gate moved from formatters.rs into the pure token_amount_decision, and the catcher upgraded from the M3 concrete boundary witness to the doubly-symbolic forall biconditional (which pins BOTH directions of the gate; the concrete witness fmt_p0_token_amount_threshold_boundary_concrete still exists in formatters.rs as the paint-integration pin). Re-verified 2026-07-06 by hand on the new location: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED (assertion is_unlimited_arm == expect_unlimited); reverted -> file restored (grep-confirmed).

disable the native-currency sentinel arm: a resolved token equal to the descriptor's Merkle-pinned nativeCurrencyAddress falls through to the erc20 ladder (UnverifiedRaw when no trailer matches) instead of Bound(18, native_ticker) -- ETH amounts on a nativeCurrencyAddress descriptor would render as raw wei with a dec=? banner, and a companion-supplied trailer could take over the sentinel's identity. The precedence forall MUST redden. Verified 2026-07-06 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED (dd == 18, ticker binding + arm asserts); reverted -> file restored (grep-confirmed).

mutations.find: let identity_page = if bound.is_none() { token_addr } else { None };
mutations.note: drop the MEDIUM-1 identity-page rule: an unbound token's resolved address is never emitted, so the user approves a transfer/withdraw/swap of an UNNAMED token (the identity-hiding class). The token-identity forall binds identity_page == Some(resolved addr) on every miss, so it MUST redden. Verified 2026-07-06 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED (d.identity_page == Some(addr)); reverted -> harness re-run SUCCESSFUL on the restored tree.

raw-word hex row 2 drifts one byte (bytes 8..16 -> 9..17): a signed byte vanishes from the trusted display (the magnitude-hiding class). The forall exactness harness binds every row byte to an independent nibble table, so it MUST redden. Verified 2026-07-04 by hand: mutation -> VERIFICATION:- FAILED; reverted -> file restored (grep-confirmed).

Neuter the ERC-20 address-word zero-padding check. A non-canonical calldata (non-zero address high bytes) then decodes to a Transfer/Approve whose displayed recipient/spender differs from the signed bytes -> parse_erc20_only_accepts_canonical MUST turn red. If it SURVIVES, the show-one/sign-another canonicity proof is vacuous. (P1.2 signed-intent-to-display, 2026-07-16.)
